column1: # Mix Pilot community pairings: transitions DJs play, one per line.
# fromArtist <TAB> fromTitle <TAB> toArtist <TAB> toTitle [<TAB> count [<TAB> when]]
# Lines starting with # are ignored. Titles are matched loosely ("(Original Mix)", "feat." and
# accents do not matter; a named remix does). my-transitions.tsv in the mod's data folder uses
# the same format, so you can share yours by adding its lines here or to a pairings_url file.
